landing.heroTagline: Smart Farming Starts With Better Decisions
landing.heroSubtitle: KrushiAI brings AI-powered crop recommendations, disease detection, market intelligence, irrigation guidance and farm planning into one simple platform.
landing.whatKrushiAiDoes: From Soil to Market — Complete Decision Support
landing.whatKrushiAiSubtitle: Traditional farming relies on guesswork, unverified advice, and distress sales. KrushiAI replaces uncertainty with data-grounded guidance across the full crop lifecycle.
landing.step1Desc: Match soil N-P-K mineral levels, pH balance, and seasonal monsoon rainfall with optimal crop candidates for maximum net margin before you buy seeds.
landing.step2Desc: Scan leaf images for early blight lesions and monitor root-zone moisture to irrigate only when crops physiologically demand it, saving diesel & electricity.
landing.step3Desc: Forecast 7 to 30 day mandi price movements and calculate transport freight to discover the highest estimated net realization across APMCs.

footer.mission: AI-powered smart agriculture decision support system for Indian smallholders. Bringing soil chemistry, foliar vision diagnosis, APMC mandi forecasting, and smart irrigation into one unified ecosystem.
footer.prototypeDesc: KrushiAI is developed as an engineering decision-support prototype. Predictions and market values are demo simulations until production ML and government API gateways are linked.
footer.copyright: KrushiAI. Built for Indian Agriculture. All rights reserved.

prototypeBanner.subtext: This is currently a functional prototype for academic demonstration. All market valuations, yield projections, and advice cards represent demonstration models. Real LSTM, CNN, and Agmarknet feeds connect in production.
